root.name: コカ・コーラ・ユーロパシフィック・パートナーズ

rows.ja: 提携・ブランド供給元

relations.text: コカ・コーラ社の製品を、域内で製造・販売・流通する権利を持つ主要ボトラー(ボトリング契約)
relations.text_en: A key bottler of Coca-Cola products, with bottling agreements to make, sell and distribute them in its territories

source.label: CCEP 年次報告書(2025年度)
source.quote: The Group is a key bottler of TCCC products and has entered into bottling agreements with TCCC to make, sell and distribute products of TCCC within the Group’s territories.

relations.text: 濃縮液の価格や支払条件などは、コカ・コーラ社が随時決める
relations.text_en: Prices, payment terms and other supply terms for concentrate are set by Coca-Cola from time to time

source.label: CCEP 年次報告書(2025年度)
source.quote: Prices, terms of payment, and other terms and conditions of supply are determined from time to time by TCCC at its sole discretion.

companies.name: モンスター・ビバレッジ

relations.text: コカ・コーラ社以外で、製品を製造・販売・流通する相手の1社としてモンスターエナジーを明記
relations.text_en: Names Monster Energy as one of the franchisors, besides Coca-Cola, whose products it makes, sells and distributes

source.label: CCEP 年次報告書(2025年度)
source.quote: primarily manufactures, sells and distributes the products of TCCC, as well as those of other franchisors, such as Monster Energy.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
